graham.brief:
Who is Tampa Bay with Daniels under center? Jalon Daniels is in line to start at quarterback for Tampa Bay with Baker Mayfield out with a thumb injury. It would be Daniels's first start of the season. Mayfield started week 3. The books hung Daniels at 27.5 pass attempts, and his average of 3 comes from one game. Green Bay is favored by 3 with a 39.5 total, which works out to about 21 points from them. Daniels resets the Tampa Bay averages.

Green Bay has struggled up front, and Tampa Bay gets after the quarterback.

Yahoo Sports NFL reports Wide receiver Chris Godwin . was a full participant. Bucky Irving is the lead back who's played 70% of the snaps, and Tampa Bay carries the 9th-heaviest injury load in the league.

The spread has moved a point toward Green Bay. Love's attempts line opened 34.5 and is 33.5 now. Bovada and Pinnacle moved Love's line first.

What I can't tell yet is whether Daniels and the Tampa Bay receivers are on the same page. The thing to count is how often Tampa Bay gets home over the first ten dropbacks, and a clean quarterback means the protection won.
